name: Gonzalez v. Thaler, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional Institutions Division

court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

parties: Gonzalez v. Thaler, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional Institutions Division.

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari granted limited to the following questions: (1) Was there jurisdiction to issue a certificate of ap-pealability under 28 U. S. C. § 2253(c) and to adjudicate petitioner’s appeal? (2) Was the application for a writ of habeas corpus out of time under 28 U. S. C. § 2244(d)(1) due to “the date on which the judgment became final by the conclusion of direct review or the expiration of the time for seeking such review"?

casebody.head_matter:
No. 10-895.
Gonzalez v. Thaler, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional Institutions Division.
